## Change summary

Describe the controller, trajectory, analysis, or documentation change.

## Validation checklist

- [ ] Python compilation passes.
- [ ] Regression tests pass.
- [ ] Generated trajectory is deterministic and endpoint-inclusive.
- [ ] Any controller behavior change has a new SITL regression archive.
- [ ] Actual-versus-desired and transition plots were reviewed.
- [ ] Timing, telemetry freshness, mode, armed state, and landing were reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, logs, or large generated files were added.
- [ ] Physical-flight claims are not made from SITL-only evidence.
